max_borrow_ratio.description: The maximum percentage of a pool's depth that can be borrowed

max_stream_length.description: The maximum number of blocks that a settlement can be chunked into over a streaming swap

min_slip_bps.description: The base layer mimir value. Will be read from chain after 3.12

reserve_fee.description: The premium charged on quotes to generate a local surplus

stream_step_ratio.description: The amount by which the `size` of the quote changes for each N of max_stream_length Allows the time-based price risk to be managed for quotes that settle over streaming swaps

Decimal.description:
A fixed-point decimal value with 18 fractional digits, i.e. Decimal(1_000_000_000_000_000_000) == 1.0

The greatest possible value that can be represented is 340282366920938463463.374607431768211455 (which is (2^128 - 1) / 10^18)
